author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a thin single-stroke S with a ring and a cross at its end, reading as a symbol (female sign / S glyph) rather than an animal. After: a thick outlined snake body band like the reference: a pointed tail at the top right, a U-turn round the left, and a rounded oval head with an eye at the lower right.
omissions: The reference's third winding and front-facing head with two eyes are reduced to one U-turn and a profile head with one eye: extra bands and two eyes can't keep 8 spacing inside 36 units.
